tool_args.rationale: The bridge archive maps the supply-bullwhip bridge to the inland-hub siphon. Responses rise saturatingly with u_now at fixed gradient, while the lower-gradient point is elevated and the higher-gradient point suppressed, consistent with a positive square-root branch and gradient inhibition. Seven rows suffice to fit the three static parameters numerically; no further probe is needed.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Same broad sink/branch structure, but the archive's bridge mapping specifically points to the simpler inland-hub siphon; current input-varying observations support its saturating factor.
Possible alternative static inhibition law, but the verified bridge signature aligns with the node_C mapping and no evidence requires Hill-2 substrate dependence.
All observations are at one horizon and the bridge signatures favor the static siphon mapping; trajectory data are unnecessary to fit the supported model.
